EA-16.name: Authorised evidence-driven process adaptation
EA-16.original_form: Inspect and adapt, retrospectives and continuous improvement.
EA-16.mechanism: Observe, analyse cause, authorise a process change, implement it and measure the subsequent result.
EA-16.mature_form: Close the complete observation-to-remeasurement loop at the level that owns the cause.
EA-16.trigger: Repeated friction, incident, queue or quality signal indicates a changeable system cause.
EA-16.native_cheap_path: Correct an obvious low-risk problem immediately rather than waiting for a scheduled meeting.
EA-16.ceremony_distinction: A retrospective meeting is neither necessary nor sufficient.
EA-16.criticism: Frequent reflection does not imply learning when participants cannot change system conditions.

EL-040.original_form: Define one best way and require conformance.

EL-040.mature_form: No immutable general standard; use risk-calibrated constraints within a versioned and reviewable baseline.
